entry.title: Emacs, how it all started (for me)
entry.summary: I have been using (_badly_) [Emacs](https://www.gnu.org/software/emacs/) since around 2008. In this short article, I will try to present the **chaotic path** that led me to choose Emacs as my main text and code editor. This is **absolutely not a tutorial**, but rather a small piece of my personal lore, because it is quite amusing to describe clumsy choices that, in hindsight, turned out to be, in my view, beneficial. This article is **largely inspired**, while being less ambitious, by the [April 2026](https://www.emacswiki.org/emacs/CarnivalApril2026) topic of the [Emacs Carnival](https://www.emacswiki.org/emacs/Carnival).
